corrections.name: zero frequency is not a zero-valued relation

Zero frequency stays in #13; it is moved out of the zero-value taxonomy table into its own category.

master.title: What is a signal? — Make the invisible visible
master.q: What is a signal? (MM)
master.rel: a physical phenomenon can be represented as a mathematical function: "something physical can be represented by a mathematical function" (MM)
master.nxt: What properties belong to the physical thing and what belong to its representation? (lock decisions)
master.trigger: the plucked string's vibration is drawn beside it as a waveform

master.title: Music as a mathematical language — Build your own sound
master.q: what if the signal measured electrical power instead of sound? (MM)
master.rel: "A function can represent different physical phenomena, but its meaning depends on what is measured." (MM)
master.nxt: what structure belongs to the function itself, whatever it measures? (gloss) — the repeating pattern (#3)
master.trigger: the same wave shape stands for sound pressure and for electrical power, with different units

master.title: Periodicity in nature — Find the repeating pattern
master.q: does a segment align with the rest of the signal, and what happens for a nonperiodic sound? (MM)
master.rel: a repeating pattern survives translation: x(t + T) = x(t); "Repetition introduces a mathematical transformation that preserves a pattern." (MM)
master.nxt: What remains unchanged under transformation? (lock decisions) — "What remains unchanged when the pattern shifts?" (MM)
master.trigger: a slid segment lights up when it aligns with a repeat, and stops aligning for an impulse
master.repo: R6, T1, C8, I1; Pair B (T-PAIRB)

master.title: Symmetry across space and time — Move without changing
master.q: "What remains unchanged when the pattern shifts?" (MM)
master.rel: translation and rotation leave the pattern unchanged: "Symmetry is connected to what remains unchanged when something moves or transforms." (MM)
master.nxt: "Could the same pattern have another representation?" (MM)
master.trigger: the dragged waveform keeps its pattern; the wheel returns to the same arrangement after a full turn
master.repo: T1–T4, TA0, the rotation case of the S4 trichotomy

master.title: What is a representation? — One thing, different mathematical views
master.q: "Are these different objects, or different descriptions of one object?" (MM)
master.rel: different mathematical views may describe the same object while preserving relations: "Mathematical representations can look different while preserving relationships." (MM)
master.nxt: Fourier: "This prepares the visitor for Fourier analysis." (MM)
master.trigger: string, waveform, rotating point and numbers update together when one is changed

master.title: Fourier series — Construct a complex wave from circles
master.q: can a complex wave be built from rotating points? (MM)
master.rel: a signal decomposes into simpler modes: f = Σ c_k e^(2πikt) (MM: "Complex signals can be represented as combinations of simpler basis functions.")
master.nxt: "Why can these components be separated?" (MM)
master.trigger: each added rotating point adds a component and the waveform grows more complex

master.title: Fourier coefficients and orthonormal bases — Give every harmonic a role
master.q: "Why can these components be separated?" (MM)
master.rel: each coefficient records the relation to a mode: f̂(n) = ⟨f, e^(2πint)⟩ (CP §1b); a coefficient can vanish while the signal does not: f̂(k) = 0, f ≠ 0
master.nxt: What relation vanished? (lock decisions)
master.trigger: removing one coefficient removes exactly one component, and a coefficient can read 0 while the signal is not 0

master.title: Orthogonality and zero — Find the relationship that disappears
master.q: What relation vanished? (lock decisions)
master.rel: orthogonality answers it: ⟨e_j, e_k⟩ = δ_jk and ⟨u, v⟩ = 0; "zero not as an empty space, but as the result of a particular mathematical relationship" (MM); orthogonal decomposition removes cross terms
master.nxt: "What does perpendicular mean beyond three dimensions?" (MM)
master.trigger: the dot product reaches 0 as the arrows become perpendicular; over a period the positive and negative parts of two basis functions cancel

master.title: Orthogonality beyond visible dimensions — Explore what cannot be seen
master.q: "What does perpendicular mean beyond three dimensions?" (MM)
master.rel: inner products in ℝⁿ and L²; a projection can show perpendicular vectors that are not orthogonal (O1b); "Geometry is not limited to physically visible dimensions." (MM)
master.nxt: — (no direct causal successor in the record; the idea is reused at #16)
master.trigger: two vectors look perpendicular in one projection while their inner product is not zero
master.repo: ON4, ON5, R8, H1, H2, Act III

master.title: Mean-square convergence — Watch infinity being approached
master.q: "how an indefinitely extendable process can approach or define a bounded or finite structure" (G2 2)
master.rel: ‖S_N − f‖₂ → 0 while the pointwise overshoot persists (C8c FAIL kept, C8c2); "Convergence depends on how we define and measure closeness." (MM)
master.nxt: "Where did the magnitude go?" (MM, #11): the mean-square measure is the squared L² norm
master.trigger: the overshoot near the jump stays while the mean-square error shrinks

master.title: Squared coefficients, length, and energy — Where did the magnitude go?
master.q: "What does mathematical energy actually measure?" (MM); "What does squared mathematical magnitude actually mean when it is not literally physical energy?" (RD, R16)
master.rel: orthogonal decomposition removes cross terms: ‖x‖² = Σ_k|a_k|², Parseval ‖f‖² = Σ|f̂(k)|² (R3); L² squared magnitude is energy-like and additive but is not automatically physical energy (A3)
master.nxt: "If mathematical energy is preserved, what other information distinguishes two representations?" (MM, #12)
master.trigger: the squared norm and the sum of squared coefficients update together; the units change when the signal is read as power

master.title: Fourier pairs — Change the representation, not the underlying information
master.q: "If mathematical energy is preserved, what other information distinguishes two representations?" (MM)
master.rel: x(t) ↔ x̂(ω); a phase change keeps |x̂| and changes x; a shift in time becomes a phase (R4); for a real signal the coefficients come in conjugate pairs (P1)
master.nxt: — (no direct causal successor at #13; the conjugate pairs lead on to #17)
master.trigger: changing only the phase leaves the magnitude display identical while the signal changes
master.repo: R4, P1, T-MAGPHASE, B5a FAIL kept, RI0, D14, D15

master.title: Zero as a mathematical cornerstone — Explore different meanings of nothing
master.q: a zero-length vector, a zero Fourier coefficient, a zero inner product, the zero-frequency component: are they the same zero? (MM)
master.rel: "Zero has different roles depending on the mathematical structure in which it appears." (MM): zero object/value, zero relation, zero index/frequency, null/balance/cancellation are different usages (Correction A)
master.nxt: "the relationship between the origin, norm, squared norm, zero, and the identity matrix" (MM, #14)
master.trigger: four situations all display 0 and behave differently
master.repo: Z1–Z13, Part IV "Kinds of zero", D7, D8, Act I, T-BACKBONE-PRIMARY

master.title: Quadratic geometry and the identity matrix — Change the rule for measuring space
master.q: What does it mean for x to be relative to zero? What are ‖x‖ and ‖x‖²? Why does the squared norm look energy-like? What happens when M ≠ I? (2026-11-16 decisions, in ‖·‖ notation)
master.rel: ‖x‖ is the distance from x to 0; ‖x‖² = x†x = q_I(x); q_M(x) = x†Mx changes the measurement (G2 7); "Geometry depends partly on how we define measurement." (MM)
master.nxt: What transformations leave that relation unchanged? → A†MA = M (CF1); If distance and magnitude depend on the geometry, how should distance be understood when the valid predictions form a model/prediction manifold? (lock decisions)
master.trigger: circles of equal distance become ellipses when M changes, though the vector has not moved

master.title: Information geometry — Turn predictions into geometry
master.q: If distance and magnitude depend on the geometry, how should distance be understood when the valid predictions form a model/prediction manifold? (lock decisions)
master.rel: ds² = dθᵀg(θ)dθ, g = JᵀJ/σ² (a position-dependent measuring rule: "distance in units of noise", CP §2); geodesics; stiff / sloppy directions; exact null directions (Z9). C7 is a later investigation inside this branch
master.nxt: "What exists beyond the visible model?" (MM, #16)
master.trigger: some parameter changes move the prediction a lot, others almost not at all

master.title: Higher-dimensional prediction space — What exists beyond the visible model?
master.q: "Could a mathematical description contain relationships that cannot be represented directly in our familiar three spatial dimensions?" (MM)
master.rel: "A mathematical space can contain more structure than a single visible projection reveals." (MM); possibility space → allowable manifold → manifestation (T-MM-STORY)
master.nxt: — (no direct causal successor at #17; the idea is later reused for time / spacetime at #18 / #19)
master.trigger: different projections of the same prediction geometry look different

master.title: Conjugacy and physical pairs — Search for hidden relationships
master.q: "Do observable physical pairings or complementarities reflect deeper symmetry analogous to mathematical conjugacy?" (RD)
master.rel: the established starting point: complex conjugate coefficient pairs give a real-valued signal, f̂(−k) = conj f̂(k) (P1). Physical pairs are not claimed to be mathematically conjugate (not proved)
master.nxt: mass-like and wave-like descriptions (R4, R18; MW1) — the parked mass-wave branch; no direct causal successor at #18

master.title: Infinity, circular geometry, and time — Your central conjecture laboratory
master.q: the historical wording "Adding an infinite object like time to a finite circle geometry makes sines and cosines converge to infinity." (MM; FAIL, kept) and its restatement: "whether this type of relationship—an unbounded quantity expressed through a bounded geometry—has deeper mathematical analogues elsewhere" (G2 8)
master.rel: The corrected relation is that an unbounded parameter can produce indefinitely continuing evolution while an observable representation remains bounded. (lock decisions): t ↦ e^(iωt) bounded, periodic, no limit; ℝ/ker χ_ω ≅ S¹. Counterexamples (irrational torus, cylinder) refine what geometry alone can imply
master.nxt: "Do these relationships tell us something about nature, or only about our mathematical descriptions of it?" (MM, after #18)
master.trigger: elapsed time and the cycle counter grow without limit while the point stays on the circle
master.repo: R6, I1–I3, D11, D37, D38; Act VIII record

master.title: Einstein, relativity, and mathematical reality — Change the observer
master.q: which measurements depend on the observer and which relationships remain invariant (MM); "If mathematics has boundaries imposed by the way it represents nature, can those boundaries be expanded?" (MM); what goes to infinity when "c converges to infinity" (G2 3)
master.rel: ΛᵀηΛ = η (L1); the observer-change parameter is the rapidity, tanh φ = v/c (L2, A8Wa); c's finite-geometry roles and its theory-family limit c → ∞ (degenerate form, Galilean boosts at fixed v, contraction: L3, A8M, A8L) stay distinct
master.nxt: "Can these mathematical ideas improve how we model finite physical resources?" (MM, after #19)
master.trigger: the measured motion changes with the observer while some relationships stay invariant

master.title: Finite energy — Can geometry reveal something useful?
master.q: Can energy behavior be represented so that hidden balances, invariants and structural relationships become geometrically explicit? (lock decisions; RD backbone: "…hidden balances, null relations, and invariants become geometrically explicit?")
master.rel: none yet: parked downstream (G2 9); physical energy ≠ L² magnitude unless a model identifies them (A3); never evidence for the upstream theory
master.nxt: — (the application test)
master.trigger: two demand patterns with the same total energy give different battery outcomes
